verdict.rationale: monday.com's integrations page advertises a directory of 850+ integrations and apps and claims connection to "thousands of other tools" with no development needed. Named integrations include Salesforce, HubSpot, GitHub/GitLab, Slack, Teams, and Zendesk, and an apps framework lets developers build more. The core story is delivered, but the native catalog is 850+, so the "thousands" figure is not substantiated, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the marketplace install/management flow, substantiation of the "thousands" claim beyond the 850+ native catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.
